provenance.notes: Names, tags and categories from the per-icon JSON files at the commit tagged with the npm version. Tags of the form $group:<id> are kept separately as `groups` (Lucide's shared tag groups, e.g. direction-left). Grid and stroke width are the modal root <svg> attributes of the published SVG files.

license.note: ISC for the set; the LICENSE file lists the icons derived from Feather, which stay under MIT.
